name: android-jev
description: Drive an Android phone attached by USB: the run_task MCP server plus the skill that teaches Claude to use it.

jev_api_key.title: Jev API key (optional)
jev_api_key.description: An OpenRouter sk-or-… key or a TypeSafe apikey_… one. Leave empty to use JEV_API_KEY or OPENROUTER_API_KEY from your environment, or to run on the keyword fallback.

args: if [ -n "$PLUGIN_JEV_API_KEY" ]; then export JEV_API_KEY="$PLUGIN_JEV_API_KEY"; fi; unset PLUGIN_JEV_API_KEY; exec uv run --quiet --frozen --directory "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT" phone-control
